label: Connection
description: Connect your sevdesk account. In sevdesk, open Einstellungen → Benutzer, choose your user, and copy the API token. Paste it here and save.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.hint: Checks the saved API token with sevdesk and shows how the account and the payment accounts are set up

fields.label: Create documents automatically for paid orders and refunds
fields.description: While this is on, an invoice is created in sevdesk when an order is paid, and a credit note when a payment is refunded. Orders in other currencies than EUR are skipped.

actions.label: Retry failed documents
actions.hint: Tries again to create every document listed under Needs attention

modal.title: Retry failed documents
modal.description: Tries again to create every invoice and credit note that is listed under Orders → sevdesk documents → Needs attention, and finishes the ones that were interrupted. Use it after you corrected what stopped them, for example the API token. A document that exists in sevdesk is never created twice.
